title: project-LICHEN-n8c6 review: OSCORE test vectors deleted instead of fixed
description: Commit 45cd828 removed test_request_protection_vectors and test_response_protection_vectors from rust/lichen-oscore/tests/vectors.rs instead of fixing them for the Context::new API change (missing id_context parameter). Also removed the second context_at overload. This eliminates test coverage for core OSCORE request/response protection against known test vectors. The tests should be fixed, not deleted.
